_about: FormTech C-300 Water & Sewer Plan drafting standard. Every property here was extracted (scripts/dwg-dump.ps1 + extract-standards.mjs) from VILLA ONE C-300 (26-04.047); the recipes are identical in the engineer's worked package (Villa One\2026-09-21_WASD - Xereft\C-300.dwg, 985 of 990 entities byte-identical to the guide), which is the base source — the guide sheet is only the visual target. Cross-checked against Goulds C-300 (26-04.046). Reuse it on every new project: scripts/c300-build-spec.mjs turns it + the new X-TOPO into one acad_create_entities batch. Update it only when the firm changes a standard, and note the date in _changelog.

template.note: Start from the previous project's C-300.dwg (styles, layouts, title block, seal). scripts/c300-prep-template.ps1 empties model space, detaches xrefs and renames layouts.

xref.note: Guide put them on C-ANNO; firm convention (Goulds fix 2026-08-05) is XREF.

alignment.geometry: single tangent along the frontage-street CL
alignment.styleNote: Yellow dashed line with ticks (guide). FASE 1 was built with the default Intersection Basic (solid purple): fix with civil3d_alignment set_style {alignmentName, style:"BCC - ALIGNMENT"} (action added 2026-09-28) or pass style at create. Station labels: label set "Major and Minor only" (civil3d_label add label_set).

streetCenterlineExtension.note: Extends each survey CL leg that dangles out of the survey limits; the main street is covered by the alignment instead.

rowDimension.source: survey dims on layer DIM (style 1 IN 20): CL -> each R/W line, one per side; copied by default since 2026-10-01 (the survey layer X-TOPO|DIM is frozen by the build, so they do not stack); text kept upright on the twisted sheet

easementCornerDimension.rule: For a SHORT aligned dimension (typically a 5' U.E./PL corner callout, span < ~10 ft), always pass explicit dimLineX/dimLineY at the line's own midpoint offset ~0.3 ft to the side (never just 'offset') -- see the short-dimension bug below. Never copy this position from the guide: compute it from the project's own xLine1/xLine2 points.
easementCornerDimension.shortDimensionBug: Found 2026-09-28 in VILLA ONE FASE 1 (handles 12235/12248, fixed as 14562/14574): acad_create_aligned_dimension used to always call RecomputeDimensionBlock(true), which lets AutoCAD's own DIMFIT auto-placement override any caller-supplied text position whenever the dimension line is too short for the annotative text to fit inside the extension lines (5 ft at 1:20 with BCC-1.0/DIMTAD=4) -- it silently ejects the text several feet away instead of erroring. Fixed 2026-09-28 in DimensionViewportCommands.cs: when the caller passes BOTH dimLineX and dimLineY, the plugin now sets dimension.TextPosition explicitly and calls RecomputeDimensionBlock(false) so AutoCAD keeps the point given instead of recalculating a default. Same fix mirrored in AcadCommands.UpdateTextContentAsync (new Dimension case) so an EXISTING dimension's text can be repositioned the same way as MText/MLeader, without erase+recreate. A dimension created with only 'offset' (no explicit dimLineX/dimLineY) still uses the old auto-placement path -- fine for dimensions long enough to fit text (the 18 other C-ANNO dims in this file, 6-25 ft, were never affected), but pass explicit dimLineX/dimLineY for anything short.

streetLabel.textFormat: SW {n}TH AVENUE | SW {n}TH STREET (no periods; survey writes S.W. 118TH AVENUE)
streetLabel.rotationRule: street direction chosen so (rotation + viewport twist) is 0 deg for the frontage street and 90 deg for cross streets (reads left-to-right / bottom-to-top on the sheet)
streetLabel.maskWhy: on the sheet the street labels sit on the CL / SAN / WM lines and the subject label on the X-ARCH house: without a background mask they print struck through (throwaway VILLA ONE build 2026-10-01); the approved FASE 1 labels are masked

clSymbol.note: Copy the survey's _cl inserts (same point/rotation) and add one ~50 ft from the intersection on labelled legs that have none. Import the definition from X-TOPO.dwg if the template lacks it.

plSymbol.placement: midpoint of every lot line shared by two plat lots (county Lot_poly, shared >= 50 ft) inside the C-300 viewport; rotation = frontage angle for lines perpendicular to the frontage street, +90 for parallel ones; glyph centered on the line. Script: scripts/c300-pl-symbols.mjs

propertyLabel.rotationRule: frontage street direction (reads horizontally after twist)
propertyLabel.fase1Note: Fase 1 label has no 'PROP {units} {sf} SF' line (user 2026-09-28); units/sf are design data and are not printed in Fase 1. The line 'SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENCE' ({use}) and '{gpd} GPD' stay unless the user says otherwise.

formats: EXIST 8" PVC (SDR-35) SAN MAIN @ {slope}% SLOPE\P(PER {asbuilt})\P(TO REMAIN)
existingUtilityLeader.source: X-UTIL + WASD as-builts (E#####-#, ES####-#) - not derivable from X-TOPO
existingUtilityLeader.rotationRule: frontage street angle (text reads horizontally after the viewport twist); dogleg along the same direction
existingUtilityLeader.placement: pipe label: arrow on the pipe 40 ft from the intersection MH (15 ft past the MH for tramos not touching it); water label 90 ft from the intersection; text 12-14 ft perpendicular on the side AWAY from the other utility, 8 ft along the pipe. MH label: arrow at MH, text 22 ft perpendicular away from water, 12 ft upstream. FH label: arrow at FH, text 12 ft further from the street CL.
existingUtilityLeader.manholeRule: label every MH drawn in X-UTIL that the survey (X-TOPO) does not already label; values from the sewer as-built
existingUtilityLeader.hydrantRule: FH block + label at the as-built F.H. ASSY coordinates (not copied from a previous sheet)
existingUtilityLeader.scaleNote: Formtech-1.0 is ANNOTATIVE: overall scale 20 comes from CANNOSCALE 1" = 20' — never pass scale (setting MLeader.Scale on an annotative leader throws eInvalidContext)

proposedLeader.scaleNote: Formtech-1.0 is ANNOTATIVE: overall scale 20 comes from CANNOSCALE 1" = 20' — never pass scale (setting MLeader.Scale on an annotative leader throws eInvalidContext)

easementLine.status: verified 2026-09-25 on VILLA ONE: guide easement = geometry derived from survey R/W + legal description within 0.09 ft
easementLine.source: recorded plat (U.E. width/which lot line); if the plat is not available the user may confirm the previous sheet's U.E., but the geometry is always rebuilt from survey R/W lines + legal lot dimensions (never copied)
easementLine.placement: two lines 5 ft each side of the lot line, from the frontage R/W line to the lot's rear line (legal depth); 5.00' aligned dims (BCC-1.0, C-ANNO) one each side ~58-64 ft from the R/W; MLeader 'EXIST 5' U.E.' (existingUtilityLeader recipe) with arrow on the lot line

existArrow.rotationRule: flow direction angle + 3.8636 rad (block drawn pointing at 221.4 deg)
existArrow.placement: on each sewer tramo, 20 ft inside each end MH, pointing downstream (flow from the as-built inverts)

existFireHydrant.source: block definition imported from the engineer's package C-300.dwg if the template lacks it (never from the guide)

utilityLines._note: Existing sanitary (SAN) and water main (WM) are marked with the survey/as-built X-UTIL xref layers below; the guide and FASE 1 render them identically (same layer props, same complex linetypes, pattern 0.95 x lts 0.5, LTSCALE/MSLTSCALE/PSLTSCALE = 1). Do not recolor them per project. Yellow (ACI 2) is the firm pen for 0.30 lineweight.
utilityLines.stormAndOverhead: X-UTIL|X-UTIL-STRM (c=2, X-UTIL|STORM LINE) and X-UTIL|X-UTIL-OVHD (c=2, OVER_HEAD_LINE) follow the same rule.
utilityLines.xTopoOverride: The guide forces 169 X-TOPO| xref layers to ACI 8 gray (EOP also DASHED2) through xref layer overrides (VISRETAIN=1). NOT applied to FASE 1 (not requested); ask the user before doing it on a new project.
utilityLines.verify: dwg-dump.ps1 <dwg> prints LAYER|X-UTIL|... rows; compare with the guide.

fase1._note: FASE 1 = existing conditions only (user 2026-09-28: everything that says PROP is a proposed design item and must not be in Fase 1). Machine-readable counterpart of references/c300-water-sewer-plan.md section 9 'Fase 1: definicion de terminado'.
forbidden: Model text/MLeaders containing PROP or PROPOSED
StationOffsetLabels SAN LAT / C.O / WATER SERVICE
hand-drawn proposed geometry on C-SAN, C-WATR-PIPE, V-SITE-FNCE (laterals, C.O. symbols, service, PROP CLF fence)

surfaceBoundary.why: the green polygon around the site is the EG TIN boundary (topography): hidden, never deleted

openDecisions: Remaining subject-label lines '{use}' (e.g. SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENCE) and '{gpd} GPD' are kept; ask the user if they must go too
tools: scripts/fase1-cleanup-plan.mjs (read-only plan for an over-built file)

civil3d_workflow_fase1_build (step 'Fase 1 notes', default on; alone with {expectedDocument} it only cleans the notes and saves): rewrites the on-sheet MD-WASD notes, erases off-sheet PROP notes, shifts the orphaned glyphs by the measured dy
scripts/fase1-build-payload.mjs + /fase1-build (whole C-300 Fase 1 build in one call)
scripts/fase1-strip-prop-notes.mjs (manual path; imports the plugin's src/tools/domains/fase1PropNotes.ts rules from build/)
scripts/fase1-notes-shift.py (manual path: dy for the orphaned '(NOT PART OF M-WASD NOTES NOR APPROVAL)' glyphs from two plots)
decisions: 2026-09-28: nothing that says PROP or PROPOSED stays in a Fase 1 file: the subject label 'PROP ONE (1) 5,200 SF' line and every MD-WASD bullet/paragraph that says PROP/PROPOSED were removed (scripts/fase1-strip-prop-notes.mjs); template notes parked off-sheet that said PROP/PROPOSED were erased
fase1.mdWaspNotes: MD-WASD NOTES MText on C-300: every bullet that says PROP/PROPOSED goes, and the 'THE FOLLOWING ACTIVITIES ON EXISTING WATER SERVICES...' block too (its only predicate says PROPOSED ACTIVITY); PROP notes parked off the ARCH D sheet (x > 36) are erased; whatever sat on the shortened note (the '(NOT PART OF M-WASD NOTES NOR APPROVAL)' glyphs, layer PDF_Geometry) moves up by the note's bottom shift. Done natively by civil3d_workflow_fase1_build (rules: src/tools/domains/fase1PropNotes.ts); manual path: scripts/fase1-strip-prop-notes.mjs + acad_update_text_content + scripts/fase1-notes-shift.py.

freezeXrefLayers.why: the survey prints its own R/W dims (some upside down) on X-TOPO|DIM; every one is mirrored by the sheet C-ANNO dims, so left visible they print doubled (VILLA ONE + guide, found 2026-10-01). fase1_build freezes them (freezeLayers) right after the xrefs; fase1_audit check 7 warns if one is visible.

styleDecisions.text: Keep the black asphalt hatch (X-TOPO|HATCH_ASPHALT) with the masked white street labels: it is the firm style. Freezing it shows the SAN/WM/MH under the street but also exposes survey texts on X-TOPO|TEXT (duplicate street names, the survey MH note with field RIM/I.E. that contradict the as-built) -> only on user request.
Label EVERY existing X-UTIL manhole inside the C-300 viewport with its as-built RIM/INV, including the connection manhole at the intersection (VILLA ONE MH#5 was missing in the guide and in FASE 1).

viewport.centerRule: point on the frontage CL midway between the far cross-street intersection and the lot label point + 25 ft along the street

titleBlock.projectTitleFormat: WATER MAIN AND SANITARY\PSEWER EXTENSION PLAN\P{PROJECT NAME}\P{ADDRESS}

templateFrom._note: values the Goulds C-300 template prints (user 2026-10-01: the title block data almost always comes from Goulds). c300-titleblock.mjs replaces them from project.json; another template -> project.json titleBlockFind {same keys}
